description: The success of the European Union's TEN-T policy and the EU Railway policy are mutually dependent: upon its finalisation in 2030, the TEN-T network will provide the physical basis for competitive rail services, while the achievement of a single european railway area will ensure that full potential of TEN-T infrastructure can be achieved. The European Rail Union network is still facing too many obstacles to achieve its objective of rail interoperability, particularly when looking at cross-border rail freight. In order to implement a truly single european rail area, a number of operational, technical and administrative barriers to rail interoperability need to be overcome urgently. One of the major hindrances to cross-border rail traffic identified by the Issue Log Book (ILB) initiative is the continued existence of a number of National (Safety) Rules. title: Technika na geodetické meranie
description: Predmetom zákazky je obstaranie techniky na geodetické meranie - max. 6 ks kompletných zostáv pre geodetické práce v teréne (kompletná zostava obsahuje geodetický GPS prístroj a geodetickú totálnu stanicu) vrátane softvéru a súvisiacich služieb. Technika na meranie pre jedného geodeta (tzv. jednomužná zostava) v počte max. 6 ks. Jedná sa o kompletnú zostavu pre geodetické práce v teréne, ktorá obsahuje geodetický GPS prístroj a geodetickú totálnu stanicu. title: Sistem radar de nori – aplicații aeropurtate
description: În vederea extinderii capabilităților de cercetare ale INCAS prin realizarea unui laborator de cercetare-inovare-instruire pentru microfizica norilor, obiectiv existent în cadrul proiectului POC “Construcția, dezvoltarea și operaționalizarea infrastructurii de cercetare-inovare-instruire destinată realizării de studii avansate atmosferice și de observare a suprafeței terestre - CAART”, - „sistem radar de nori – aplicații aeropurtate”. Această achiziție va crește nivelul de inovare-educație, astfel fiind asigurată includerea INCAS în categoria celor mai performante instituții din Europa, dar și recunoașterea singurului centru (pol de excelență) national pentru cercetare-inovare-instruire pentru microfizica norilor. De asemenea, prin intermediul acestei achiziții, INCAS intenționează să îți consolideze rolul în cadrul rețelei ACTRIS, contribuind la extinderea rețelei prin dezvoltarea unei stații de teledetecție a norilor. Suplimentar dezvoltării stații de teledetecție a norilor, INCAS dorește să furnizeze seturi de date colectate cu ajutorul instrumentelor teledetecție a norilor amplasate la bordul platformelor aeropurtate. Utilizarea acestor tipuri de platforme complet echipate pentru determinări atmosferice va permite îmbunătățirea cunoștințelor actuale din acest domeniu, oferind totodată mijloace pentru elucidarea mecanismelor specifice anumitor fenomene atmosferice. Acesta achiziție va include următoarele: sistem radar de nori – aplicații aeropurtate (inclusiv accesorii), hardware și pachete software specifice, documentație tehnică suport necesară instalării echipamentului pe o platforma aeropurtată în vederea certificării ulterioare a acestei platforme conform reglementărilor aeronautice, servicii de livrare a echipamentelor în locația beneficiarului – INCAS, instalarea/testarea/punerea în funcțiune, în condiții de laborator, la locația indicată de beneficiar, garanția și mentenanța pe perioada garanției, instruirea personalului beneficiarului pentru utilizarea/exploatarea echipamentelor și a accesoriilor conexe, precum și toate accesoriile necesare instalării, punerii în funcțiune, testării și utilizării echipamentelor. 1. title: I-HAB  Data Handling Special Check Out Equipment  (DH-SCOE)
description:
The Cislunar Gateway International Habitat (I-HAB) is ESAs contribution of an infrastructure element supporting the Gateway with full crew habitability and utilization requirements from 2025. The I-HAB includes contributions from USA, Japan and Canada. The Cislunar Gateway is a multi-element infrastructure designed to support both robotic and human exploration of cis-lunar space and act as a basecamp for sustained lunar exploration. The Lunar Gateway is smaller than the ISS and will require less launches for its assembly. It is intended to be occupied by a crew of up to four astronauts for periods ranging from two weeks to two months, but otherwise operates as a robotic spacecraft.The objective of the present procurement is the selection of the contractor Data Handling Special Check Out Equipment (DH-SCOE) in accordance with the principles of ESA Best Practices.The Data Handling Special Check Out Equipment (and DH-SCOE) is part of the support equipment to integrate and test the I-HAB Gateway module.
The Data Handling Special Check Out Equipment (DH-SCOE) function is to handle MIL-1553 buses, RS-422 serial lines, command & control of I-HAB module/units over TTEthernet and simulate I/O signals Notwithstanding the complete list of countries identified in the Special Provision for visibility purposes, the ITT letter of invitation will contain a dedicated set of geographical return requirements/targets to be considered.Further information concerning the I-HAB can be found on the Agencys website here:https://www.esa.int/Science_Exploration/Human_and_Robotic_Exploration/Gateway_to_the_Moon

The BIOMASS programme was selected as the 7th Earth Explorer mission in
Spring 2013 at the User Consultation Meeting in Graz, Austria. The overall
objective of the mission is to reduce the uncertainty in the worldwide
spatial distribution and dynamics of forest biomass in order to improve
current assessments and future projections of the global carbon cycle.

The objective will be achieved by implementation of a P-band SAR mission,
providing global maps of forest biomass stocks, forest disturbance and
growth.

This notification of Intended Invitation To Tender concerns the procurement
of the Instrument Electronic System (INES) Satellite Checkout Equipment 
(SCOE) by Airbus Defence and Space GmbH as a Core team 
member of the Biomass project. The supplier selection will be made in 
accordance with the principles of ESA Best Practices.

The Instrument Electronics System (INES) comprises the following subsystems:
- Central Electronics Subsystem (CES) including a Digital Control Unit (DCU), 
 Calibration Distribution Network (CDN), 
 all supported by an Application Software (ASW)
- Power Amplifier Subsystem (PAS)
- Receive Amplifier Subsystem (RAS)

The Feed Array is part of the BIOMASS Antenna System and has the function 
of transmitting and receiving the RF signals to and from the LDR (Large 
Deployable Reflector) by the INES. The LDR is an element of the Platform 
and forms together with the Instrument the SAR Payload.

The primary function of the INES SCOE is to provide the Biomass satellite
platform interfaces to the Instrument before it is integrated onto the 
platform. Hence, the INES SCOE shall provide the same interface types, 
interface connectors and functionalities than the ones provided by the 
platform, allowing interface verification and functional testing on Biomass 
Instrument AIT level prior to delivery to Biomass Satellite system 
integration, where the INES SCOE will be fully replaced by the satellite 
platform.
